csv_project_name: DB for Westside Dog Park Off NW 108th Terrace
csv_scope_of_work: Design-Build of the Westside Dog Park project off NW 108th Terrace. The project site is approximately 0.55 acres, located within an existing City owned parcel along NW 108th Terrace, south of the Sanibel Recreation Center & Club House and west of the Devon community (refer to Attachment 1 - Site map attached herein). The proposed elements include a fenced area for both large and small dogs (separate areas), 5-foot concrete walking path, water fountain for dogs, pet disposal stations, 2 covered/shaded benches, trash receptacles, landscaping, signage, video surveillance, Wifi and other associated elements.
